Then, he made clear just how badly he wanted to battle after a tough few months. 

“I just wanted to go showcase how much I want to play and how much I deserve to be here."

media.title: The Celtics’ newest player excels in debut game against Cavaliers
media.description: Devin Carter had a strong showing in his first game as a Celtic — and reflected on a tumultuous couple of months after the game.
